name: ai-studio-agent-skills-manifest
description: Manifest catalog of 15 integrated agent skills for website design, engineering, animation, optimization, and auditing.

skills.name: Emil Design Engineering
skills.summary: UI polish, micro-interactions, spring physics, and subtle details making interfaces feel great.

skills.name: Anthropic Frontend Design
skills.summary: Intentional artistic direction, typography hierarchy, and non-generic aesthetic constitution.

skills.name: ag-kit Frontend Design
skills.summary: Anti-slop web UI guidelines, real component systems, audit-first redesigns, and strict pre-flight checks.

skills.name: Tailwind Design System
skills.summary: Tailwind CSS v4 design tokens, CSS-first architecture, component variants, and consistent utility schemas.

skills.name: Color Palette
skills.summary: Generation of accessible color palettes (50-950), semantic tokens, dark mode variants, and WCAG contrast checks.

skills.name: GSAP Core
skills.summary: Core tweening engine (to, from, fromTo), duration, easing, stagger, defaults, and matchMedia.

skills.name: GSAP Timeline
skills.summary: Choreographing multi-step animation sequences, position parameters, nesting, and playback controls.

skills.name: GSAP ScrollTrigger
skills.summary: Scroll-linked animation, section pinning, scrubbed motions, and viewport enter/leave triggers.

skills.name: GSAP Plugins
skills.summary: Specialized plugins: Flip layout transitions, Draggable, Inertia, SplitText, and CustomEase.

skills.name: GSAP React
skills.summary: Official React integration with useGSAP hook, scoping refs, and automatic teardown cleanup.

skills.name: GSAP Performance
skills.summary: 60/120fps optimization, transform prioritization, will-change management, and layout thrashing prevention.

skills.name: Cloudflare Web Performance
skills.summary: Network delivery, HTTP protocols, edge caching, compression (Brotli), and asset preloading.

skills.name: Performance Optimization
skills.summary: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), JS bundle pruning, code splitting, and lazy loading strategies.

skills.name: Web Design Reviewer
skills.summary: Visual inspection, responsive breakage detection, accessibility audits, and source-level fixes.

skills.name: Prompt Engineer
skills.summary: Designing, refactoring, and evaluating system prompts, JSON schemas, guardrails, and few-shot patterns.
